punchline: The quickest way to stop procrastinating might be to book your weekend before you touch your to-do list.
thirty_sec: In The Now Habit, Neil Fiore noticed that procrastinators and overworkers share a rule: no rest until the work is done. Since work is never done, it starts to feel like a sentence you resent and avoid. His fix is the Unschedule. You put commitments and guilt-free play on the calendar first, then log short, focused 30-minute work blocks after you finish them. Limited work time feels valuable, so starting gets easier.
question: If your free time this week were fixed and untouchable, how would you spend the hours that were left for work?
